frame: the model's own frame, the same frame the released 6-DoF object poses act on: point_world = quaternion(objects[].Q) * p + objects[].T
method: area-weighted samples over the glb triangles, with the glTF node hierarchy applied; seeded per object uid so the cloud is reproducible
